name: Adium
description: Sparkle 1.x with a pinned DSA pubkey; solid design (project dead since 2021).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Adium’s application metadata configures an HTTPS Sparkle feed and a bundled DSA key file. The source supports this key configuration; historical releases and framework enforcement remain unverified.
limitations: Recovered default-branch snapshot rather than original study checkout; feed configuration, historical release artifacts, and Sparkle framework verification internals were not independently audited.
